summary: A mixed day with retail distribution disruption, Reliance capital raising, and key regulatory rulings. Vadilal's 10-year distribution pact blocked, Reliance raising $1.3 billion in rupee bonds, and Bombay High Court intervening on liquor restrictions.

bullets.text: Vadilal Enterprises blocks renewal of 10-year distribution pact with ice cream maker Vadilal Industries.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion in rupee bond sale, first since 2023.
Bombay High Court reduced Pune liquor ban during Ganesh festival from 10 days to 2 days.
Quick commerce platforms expanding beyond groceries into electronics and beauty products via Flipkart initiatives.
Texas judge ruled TikTok misled users by internally classifying violative content as 'hard to find' rather than 'do not allow.'
